name: workflows
description: WORKFLOW.md discovery/authoring (workflow_list/read/phase/create/match, describe_workflow) and workflow run execution (run_workflow, complete_workflow, await_workflow, list_workflow_runs, read_workflow_run_log). Also adds workflow_cancel: the host cannot cancel an in-flight extension call (one request/one response, no forwarded context), so await_workflow can be released early by flipping a per-run cancel flag inside this extension. Workflows live in <workspace>/workflows, run logs in <workspace>/workflow-logs; the in-memory run map does not survive an extension restart.
